messages:
sam: Paging not hitting customers or oncall since ~12:03 UTC. I see failures from sms-gw with 401/403 responses. incident-bot did not escalate. Anyone oncall?
vivian: I'm looking. logs show auth failures when signing header for sms-gw provider. last successful send ~12:01 then 401 on rotate.
chen: Paging queue shows retries but they get suppressed by our rate limiter after 3 failures. also seeing 504s from our outbound proxy intermittently.
pagerflow-bot: outbound webhook results: provider=twilio-gw attempts=5 last_status=401 last_body="Invalid signature"
sam: @incident-bot didn't page because suppression window flagged it as a duplicate - but duplicates are legitimate here. we need manual escalation.
raj: I'm oncall and taking this. marking as active incident. immediate mitigation: get pages out via backup provider or manual send. who can run the runbook?
natalie: CS says 4 customers reported missing alerts (ticketed). escalate customer-impacted list -> ops to notify.
vivian: quick check — looks like key rotation for sms-gw signing went out ~11:59 but the provider didn't accept the new key; our signed header now rejected. rotation script didn't validate handshake.
chen: workaround plan: 1) switch incident-bot to use fallback provider `sms-fallback` 2) disable suppression for this event channel 3) send manual page via shell script.
sam: I'll run the manual fallback. commands:
```
# send test page via fallback provider
./tools/send_sms --provider=sms-fallback --to="+1..." --msg="test page from fallback"
```
sam: test page succeeded to my phone (got delivered).
incident-bot: manual trigger: sending escalation to oncall via sms-fallback (script) :white_check_mark:
ops-rotation: I disabled suppression for #incidents for the next 30m so retries won't be squelched.
chen: pushed a temporary config to incident-bot to use sms-fallback for outbound pages. please validate.
raj: confirmed received pages from multiple oncall members. good. please keep manual monitoring for 30m.
natalie: CS notified affected customers that we're investigating and using manual pages. one customer asked for confirmation when fixed.
vivian: short-term fix: revert to previous signing key and re-run handshake with provider. long-term: add handshake validation & canary to rotation process.
chen: I'll open a PR for rotation validation and add automated rollback on 5xx/4xx. also adding more explicit metrics: outgoing-401s per provider.
sam: for incident timeline: detection ~12:03 (alerts not delivered), mitigation manual fallback ~12:10, oncall pages restored ~12:14.
raj: severity assessment: partial customer impact and oncall delay -> mark P2 but flagging for expedited postmortem.
vivian: created a hotfix branch and will coordinate a key revert with provider support. vendor says they started rejecting previous key TTLs around 11:59 due to unexpected signing format change.
chen: scheduled follow-ups: 1) rotation validation PR 2) incident-bot suppression logic tweak (allow override) 3) retry/backoff and alert when provider auth fails > 3 min.
ops-rotation: we've set a temporary runbook checkpoint and assigned follow-up owners: vivian (rotations), chen (bot logic), natalie (customer comms).
raj: creating incident ticket & timeline. please drop any additional customer reports here.
natalie: updating status page with note about SMS delivery degradation; linking to ticket. :loudspeaker:
sam: after we fully revert and test with provider we'll re-enable automatic rotation. keep pagerflow metrics on watch.
vivian: will coordinate postmortem doc and RCA draft by EOD tomorrow. adding remediation items and an ops playbook change.
chen: logs/queries I used: `select count(*) from outbound_pages where status in ('401','403') and provider='twilio-gw' and ts > '2024-06-01'` — will paste results to ticket.
raj: Thanks all. current status: pages restored via fallback, provider auth failure is root cause, manual workarounds applied. next: hotfix + PM for postmortem.
sam: adding small note: incident-bot should have better visibility for provider auth errors (not just rate-limits). filing as action item. :memo:
incident-bot: closing manual mitigation phase. please keep channel updated for any regressions.
